ledger.claim: The cancellation fell inside the match grace, and POL-NS-10(a) measures that grace from accepted_at, not from the booking request: a rider's cancellation within platform_policy.grace_after_match_sec of the trip_record accepted_at timestamp is not chargeable, whatever the driver's position, and the driver's early arrival does not shorten it. The trip record shows accepted_at 2026-09-15T15:07:39+08:00 and cancelled_at 2026-09-15T15:09:39+08:00 - exactly 120 seconds, comfortably inside the 180-second grace_after_match_sec carried in this trip's own platform_policy.

The consequence is a full refund. POL-NS-10(c) directs that a cancellation fee charged on a cancellation which limb (a) makes non-chargeable is refunded in full with no driver compensation. The fare breakdown confirms the money: the $4.50 cancellation fee is the whole of total_charged, payment_status is CHARGED, and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00 - so the full $4.50 remains outstanding to the rider.

The fee cannot be defended as a no-show. POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable only if all four limbs hold, and two of them fail on this record. Limb (a) requires a driver 'arrived' event for the trip, but arrived_at is null and no arrival event appears in the record's event list. Limb (d) requires termination with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, but the recorded code is RIDER_CANCELLED, which is none of the three recognised codes.

The driver's own trace confirms he was nowhere near the pickup. His closest approach to the pickup pin over the whole trace is 6,833 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m) and his mean distance is 8,250 m - far outside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius POL-NS-02 sets, and far outside even the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling POL-NS-03 allows. No qualifying in-radius fix exists anywhere in the trace, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test both fail.

There was no in-geofence dwell at all, so POL-NS-01(c) cannot be satisfied. The trace records 0 qualifying fixes inside the arrival radius (derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count) and a longest qualifying run of 0 seconds (derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec), while the driver's speed ran between 57 and 62 km/h throughout (derived.driver_track.distinct_speeds_kph). No part of the 180-second free waiting period was served before the 15:09:39 cancellation.

Nor can the fee be rescued by summing separate in-geofence intervals. POL-NS-06(i) permits accumulation only where a populated traffic_advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road; EV-ADVIS-02737-01 is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0), so limb (i) is unavailable on this record and the dwell shortfall stands.

The driver's advocate does not stretch the timestamps, because they will not stretch: trip_record records accepted_at at 2026-09-15T15:07:39 and cancelled_at at 2026-09-15T15:09:39, so the rider's cancellation fell 120 seconds after match - inside the 180-second grace that platform_policy.grace_after_match_sec carries on this very trip. Under POL-NS-10(a) that cancellation is not chargeable whatever the driver's position, and under POL-NS-10(c) the SGD 4.50 cancellation-fee line on the fare breakdown falls to be refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable under POL-NS-07.

The driver never claimed an arrival, so no false-arrival finding can be laid at his door: trip_record.events contains only driver_assigned, driver_en_route and trip_cancelled, arrived_at is null and there are no wait-timer events, while the derived arrival block of EV-GPS-02737 reports qualifying_fix_count 0 and a longest qualifying run of 0 seconds across 18 driver fixes lying 6,833 m to 9,667 m from the pickup pin. There is no arrival marker for POL-NS-05 to impugn, and no false-arrival referral, driver-education item or POL-NS-02 non-arrival finding should be recorded against this driver in the ruling.

The rider has no contact-failure or driver-fault route to the refund in this bundle, and the fee turns on the grace timestamps alone: the chat log holds 0 messages and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so POL-NS-04 limb (a) cannot be satisfied at all, and the driver began moving toward the pickup 8 seconds after assignment (driver_en_route at 15:07:47) and held 57-63 km/h across all 18 fixes with no stationary interval, so the first POL-NS-10(f) exception - that the driver had not begun moving within the grace - is equally unavailable. The rider's refund, if it comes, comes from the clock, not from any failure of this driver.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is clean on this driver and cannot be turned against him: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 against completed_trips_30d of 113, so neither the absolute limb (4 or more terminations) nor the rate limb (greater than 0.08) is engaged, and nothing in this profile supports withholding, an escalation under POL-NS-09(d), or any adverse finding. ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver, this one turns on a clock, and both advocates have read it correctly.

WHY THE FEE COMES BACK. POL-NS-10(a) runs the free cancellation grace from the moment the trip is accepted, not from the booking request, and it is not shortened by anything the driver does. Trip record EV-TRIP-02737 shows accepted_at 2026-09-15T15:07:39+08:00 and cancelled_at 2026-09-15T15:09:39+08:00 - 120 seconds - and this trip's own platform_policy carries grace_after_match_sec 180. The cancellation therefore falls inside the grace, is not chargeable whatever the driver's position, and POL-NS-10(c) directs a full refund of the fee so charged with no driver compensation. The rider's two minutes is comfortably inside the three minutes.

AMOUNT. Fare breakdown EV-FARE-02737 shows total_charged SGD 4.50, made up solely of a cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.50, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The full SGD 4.50 is refunded to the rider. driver_compensation_sgd is null: POL-NS-10(c) excludes driver compensation and POL-NS-07 is not engaged.

THE FEE IS NOT A DEFENSIBLE NO-SHOW. Both sides are right that POL-NS-01 fails. Limb (a) needs a driver 'arrived' event and there is none - arrived_at is null and the event list holds only driver_assigned, driver_en_route and trip_cancelled. Limb (d) needs termination under RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, and the recorded code is RIDER_CANCELLED, which is none of the three. The rider's proximity points also stand: GPS trace EV-GPS-02737 puts the driver's closest approach at 6,833 m (min_distance_m) and mean distance 8,250 m, with 0 qualifying in-radius fixes, a longest qualifying run of 0 seconds and speeds of 57-62 km/h throughout - far outside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius and outside even the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling. POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable as well, because there are no in-geofence intervals to sum; the missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02737-01 (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0) carries no deciding fact and its absence is adverse to neither party.

NO REFERRALS. There is no 'arrived' event and no wait-timer event, so POL-NS-05 has no marker to impugn and no false-arrival record or driver-education item is entered against this driver. POL-NS-04 does not apply: chat log EV-CHAT-02737 holds 0 messages and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so limb (a) cannot be met, and the refund rests on the clock rather than on any failure by the driver.

DRIVER PROFILE. No adverse finding is made. driver_profile EV-DPROF-02737 shows no_show_terminations_30d 0 against completed_trips_30d 113, so the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip and POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged. The rating, acceptance rate, account age and lifetime counters named in argument - prior_no_show_flags and prior_deviation_flags among them - are context only under POL-GEN-01 and have been used as a ground in neither direction.

CONFIDENCE AND INTEGRITY. The deciding facts are carried by trip record EV-TRIP-02737 and fare breakdown EV-FARE-02737, both COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0; the GPS trace is COMPLETE at 1.0 with 100 percent coverage and no gaps, the chat log's 0 messages reconcile with trip_record.chat_message_count 0, and the fare ledger reconciles to the cent against platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd. No artifact meets the POL-NS-08(a)-(d) impairment limbs and nothing this ruling rests on is down-weighted under POL-GEN-02, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is set at 0.95.

The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically on issue, subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
